To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
regular exercise reduces the risk for chronic metabolic and cardio respiratory diseases, in part, because exercise exerts an anti-inflammatory effect.

exercise exerts anti-inflammatory effects via both a reduction of visceral fat mass (and subsequent decreased release of inflammatory adipokines) as well as an acute anti-inflammatory environment with each exercise bout.
exercise has anti inflammatory effects, which are mediated in part by a reduction in visceral adiposity and by the induction of anti inflammatory mediators during exercise.
In summary, our research is concerned with

understanding the molecular mechanisms by which exercise exerts its anti-inflammatory effects and with translating this knowledge into novel therapeutic strategies for treating chronic inflammatory diseases.
the anti inflammatory and immune modulating effects of regular exercise, and how these effects may be mediated via the gut microbiome.
the mechanisms underlying the anti inflammatory and anti oxidant effects of exercise.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
exercise is anti inflammatory.
regular exercise is anti-inflammatory.
regular physical activity and exercise is beneficial for health and well being.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
exercise is an anti inflammatory intervention that can be prescribed for the prevention and management of a wide variety of diseases.
exercise is a powerful anti inflammatory stimulus that can be used therapeutically to reduce the burden of inflammatory disease.
regular exercise is an important anti inflammatory therapy for the prevention and management of disease.
The main takeaway from our work is that
exercise is a potent anti inflammatory stimulus, and the anti inflammatory effects of acute and chronic exercise are mediated via a variety of different mechanisms.

regular exercise is associated with an anti inflammatory state that may contribute to the prevention and/or treatment of a variety of chronic diseases, but this effect must be weighed against the increased susceptibility to infection.
exercise is a powerful anti inflammatory agent.
